review:
Bonanza Billion turned up to eleven. Same fruity cascades and rainbow symbols, but with golden bomb multipliers and a Super Free Spins mode bolted on.

It's built for big multiplier moments, and the ceiling reflects that: 20,000x, the highest in the Bonanza family. The trade-off is time – free spins average around once every 395 spins, so most of a session is base game. 96.97% RTP. If the original felt too tame, this is the version to try.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
